review_evidence: Reviewed all 95 primary Lean files. The repository is the machine-checked artifact for Kannan--Bachem Smith reduction and contains hundreds of theorem/lemma declarations across matrix normal forms, certificates, arithmetic traces and polynomial complexity bounds.

NormalFormsTests.lean is deliberately retained: it contains checked public-API regression examples and a determinant theorem. scripts/AxiomAudit.lean was inspected separately as a run_cmd-only dependency audit over retained published endpoints.

rules.content_invariant: The file declares no mathematical object or theorem; it imports NormalForms, collects axioms for ten retained endpoint declarations and throws/logs based on the resulting report, so excluding it cannot hide unique formal mathematics.
evidence: Complete scripts/AxiomAudit.lean inspected: one run_cmd traverses a fixed declaration array with Lean.collectAxioms.
rules.rationale: This exact script only computes and reports the axiom dependencies of already-retained published Kannan--Bachem declarations.

summary: Reviewed lean-normal-forms; retain the complete mathematical artifact and regression examples, excluding only the axiom-audit reporting script.
